$R: the `limit` in the details of the error "projectile-work-limit", in rendering.js and in Grid.js
VR: Grid.js rejects a projectile's `slope`, `startOffset`, `startHeight`, `endHeight` or `height` beyond this number (written out there) with "invalid-geometry"; nothing reads the binding itself
qR: Grid.js pairs it with the key "groundItems" of a frame's state, next to ["npcs", snapshotNpcLimit], and reports "snapshot-work-limit"
YR: the `limit` of "snapshot-work-limit" in Grid.js for one frame's sum of every NPC's `size ** 2` plus one per ground item; "footprint" is inferred
XR: the `limit` of "snapshot-work-limit" in Grid.js for that sum over all frames; "footprint" is inferred
JR: rendering.js and Grid.js throw "invalid-clock" when it fails for a `startCycle`, an `endCycleExclusive` or 30 times a tick; "safe" from ReplaySafetyError
QR: Grid.js throws "invalid-geometry" when it fails for a `position`, `sourcePosition` or `targetPosition`; "safe" from ReplaySafetyError
eP: Grid.js throws "invalid-geometry" when it fails for a `size`, `primaryNpcSize` or `targetSize`; "safe" from ReplaySafetyError
